exp.desc:
- 6,000 products and two marketplaces
- Conversion from 1.1 to 2.3 per cent
- Monthly reporting to the directors

cl.p1: two years ago our shop converted at 1.1 per cent. Today it is 2.3. I restructured the product pages, cut checkout from five steps to three and worked with customer service to answer the ten most common questions right on the page.
cl.p2: I have run the web shop of a sports retailer with 6,000 products for four years, plus two marketplaces. I work closely with buying, warehouse and marketing and report monthly to the directors. Outdoor gear is my own world – every holiday I spend in the hills.

cl.p1: during the pandemic I built an online shop for our small wool shop in three weeks. It now brings in forty per cent of revenue, and I learned everything myself: product photos, shipping, reviews, newsletters.
cl.p2: I am handing the shop over to my successor and would like to bring this experience to a larger business. Your shop is beautiful in person and has room to grow online, and I already have a few ideas.

letters.label: Shop owner who built her own web shop
